start: Friend's phone, a WhatsApp message from a member with the link app.mettleup.fit/f/<CODE>

user_sees: The gym's name as the title
'<member first name> invited you to train here.' with the Hinglish line under it
'Only <gym> sees your number. <member> does not.'
must_not: A blank page or endless loading
Another gym's name or logo
The member's phone number or full name

steps.action: Type a name in 'Your name', a 10-digit number after +91 in 'Mobile number', pick 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening' or 'Any time'
user_sees: The typed values stay in the boxes
'Any time' picked unless changed
must_not: An error shown before Send is tapped
The number box taking letters as part of the number

user_sees: 'Sent. <gym> will call you soon.' with 'Bhej diya. <gym> aapko jaldi call karega.'
must_not: Two enquiries in the gym for one tap
The form still shown as if nothing was sent
The enquiry landing in another gym

start: Friend opens an invite link whose member has no first name on record

user_sees: 'A friend invited you to train here.'
'Only <gym> sees your number. Your friend does not.'
must_not: The word 'undefined' or an empty name in the line
A broken sentence

steps.action: Fill the form and tap 'Send to the gym'
user_sees: 'Sent. <gym> will call you soon.'
must_not: The send refused because the inviter has no name

start: Friend on the invite page with the form open

steps.action: Leave 'Your name' empty and type 9 digits, tap 'Send to the gym'
user_sees: Under the name: 'Type your name.' / 'Apna naam likhiye.'
Under the number: 'Type a 10-digit mobile number.'
The cursor goes to the name box
must_not: Anything sent to the gym
The form cleared

steps.action: Send correctly 5 times from the same Wi-Fi, then a sixth time
user_sees: 'Too many requests from this link today. Please try again tomorrow.'
must_not: A sixth enquiry in the gym
'Sent.' shown for a send that was refused

steps.action: Open a link with a mistyped code (letters O or I, or 7 letters)
user_sees: 'Invite not found' or 'This invite link does not work any more'
must_not: The form shown for a code that cannot work
An error page from the server

start: Invite page open; meanwhile the member's invite code stops working (member left or the gym turned Bring a friend off)

steps.action: Fill the form and tap 'Send to the gym'
user_sees: 'This invite link does not work any more' / 'Yeh invite link ab kaam nahi karta'
The form is hidden
must_not: 'Sent.' shown
The enquiry saved without a member to credit

steps.action: Open the same link again later
user_sees: 'Invite not found'
must_not: The old form coming back for a dead code

start: Friend has sent the form; the member who invited them opens their app

user_sees: 'Sent. <gym> will call you soon.'
must_not: The number stored anywhere but that gym's Enquiries

steps.action: The inviting member looks at their Bring a friend count in the app
user_sees: Only how many friends joined
must_not: The friend's name or number shown to the member
The enquiry visible to any other gym

start: Member has shared their invite link and opens it in the phone browser to see what the friend sees

user_sees: The gym's name, logo or its first letter
'<own first name> invited you to train here.'
'Only <gym> sees your number. <own first name> does not.'
must_not: The member's phone number or surname on the page
Another member's name

start: Member opens a copy of their link with the code cut short by the chat app

steps.action: Open app.mettleup.fit/f/ with 7 letters, or with the code missing
user_sees: 'Invite not found'
must_not: A form shown that can never send
A server error page

start: A friend already in the gym's Enquiries is invited again by the member

steps.action: The friend sends the form again with the same number
user_sees: The friend sees 'Sent. <gym> will call you soon.'
In the gym's Enquiries the old enquiry shows 'Invited again by' and the member's name
must_not: A second enquiry for the same number
The member not credited for the second invite

start: Two friends sent the form from the member's link

steps.action: Member looks at Bring a friend in the app
user_sees: How many friends joined
must_not: Either friend's number or name shown to the member
Friends of other members counted
